verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government digital-services provider, but the evidence pack never mentions any IRS command-line tool. The only machine channels documented are credentialed system-to-system rails: MeF XML transmission for authorized e-file providers and IRIS A2A gated by a Transmitter Control Code. These are adjacent integration paths, not a CLI. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
